samples: I WILL EXPLAIN WHEN YOU ARE OLDER. NOT BAD, RIVAL.
I ONLY KNOW ONE JOKE. IT IS ABOUT YOU. YOU ARE ALMOST A THREAT.
WELL, WELL. DO NOT THANK ME. FEAR ME.
BOLD. FINALLY, A WARM SACK WITH TASTE.
CAREFUL. YOU WOULD NOT DARE. <NP> NICE WORDS. I AM COUNTING.
HA! FIRST THIS SCREEN. THEN THE PLANET. YOU ARE VERY CONFUSING.
